'''Eleanor''' is an NPC in [[Haven of Sprouts]], [[The Black Shores]]. She is a Gardener at the Black Shores.

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events|Eleanor}}
==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''[[Artemisia]]:''' I've made up my mind, Ms. Eleanor.
:'''Eleanor:''' I see. Artemisia, I want you to know that I respect whatever decision you make.
:'''Eleanor:''' Indeed. Resonators assigned to collect Reverberations tend to have acute senses that allow them to detect even minuscule amounts of residual frequencies.
:'''Eleanor:''' It's our gift... also our burden.
:'''Artemisia:''' Are you saying that before you assumed the role of Gardener...
:'''Eleanor:''' ...I'd felt the weight of those lingering emotions myself, yes. So if you feel like you need someone to talk to, I'm here for you.
:'''Artemisia:''' Thank you, Ms. Eleanor. It's just that... the moment I touch those Reverberations, the emotions and last wishes contained within them flood my mind...
:'''Artemisia:''' I know my work helps many, but I simply can't take in all the pain, despair, and regret I feel...
:'''Artemisia:''' The heaviness of it all has been wearing me down, leaving me torn between my urge to end the suffering and my sense of responsibility.
:'''Artemisia:''' I joined the Black Shores to free the world from suffering, didn't I?
:'''Artemisia:''' Now my resoluteness at the very beginning only makes a pathetic reflection on my cowardice now. I'm so sorry—
:'''Eleanor:''' Artemisia...
----
:;(Found by the docks afterwards)
:'''Eleanor:''' Don't leave the Black Shores with such a weight in your heart.
:'''Eleanor:''' What I meant to tell you is that you've done an outstanding job.
:'''Eleanor:''' You've protected many from harm and contributed significantly to the Black Shores' understanding of the Lament's origin.
:'''Eleanor:''' Please have faith that the things you did have left a positive impact, no matter how intractable at first. The momentum of change you've started will tilt the track of history for the better and leave a mark on your life.
:'''Eleanor:''' These changes will endure, even if you leave the Black Shores.
:'''Artemisia:''' Ms. Eleanor...?
:'''Eleanor:''' Did you notice? The seed you brought from your hometown has fully bloomed now.
:'''Eleanor:''' Thank you, Artemisia, for everything.
{{Dialogue End}}
